name: minimax-ai/minimax-code-miniapps
title: MiniMax Code makes Mini Apps an open standard: agent-built tools with their own port, agent and data directory
summary: In MiniMax Code a user describes a tool and the agent builds a persistent mini app (manifest, frontend and Node server) that keeps its own data and stays usable across conversations; the spec and a community repo are public.
